release_notes:
FocusDefend v3.4.4 — Autonomous Background OTA Self-Update & Deep Polish:
• Seamless Background OTA Auto-Update: Checks for updates automatically on app launch and foreground resume without needing to tap 'Check for updates'. Automatically downloads in background and launches the Android package installer.
• Android REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES Permission: Cleanly registered in AndroidManifest.xml and FileProvider for instant in-app self-updating.
• Zero Placeholder Questions: 100% authentic CBSE & NCERT curriculum across Class 5–12 Science, Math, and Social Studies. Cleaned out all legacy template prompts.
• System App Name Resolution: Fixed 'android Paused' glitch to accurately display 'System Settings' or the actual app name.
• 3/3 Focus Sprint Requirement: Stricter sprint unlock requiring 3 consecutive correct questions instead of unlocking on just 1.
• Crash-Proof Study Mode & Analytics: Full null safety and persistent state across app transitions.
